purpose: Permit CPU execution when the original 58,999,099-byte container archive is not transportable to the CPU runner, by reconstructing only the authorized 2022-2024 underlying members from their original Upstox URLs and requiring byte-for-byte equality to the hashes and byte lengths recorded in the locked genuine-source manifest.

authorized_members.verification: Every downloaded member must match its locked expected byte length and SHA256 exactly. A single missing/mismatched member fails closed. Current Upstox transport omits the historical trailing LF; appending exactly one LF is permitted only when that operation produces the exact locked byte length and SHA256.

forbidden: accepting semantically similar but hash-different candle data
relaxing any R3E threshold or gate
